name: camphor (natural) + glycerin
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves pain and itching associated with fever blisters and cold sores. Relieves dryness and softens cold sores and fever blisters
otcwarn: Stop Use and ask a doctor if condition worses, symptoms last more than 7 days, or condition clears up and occurs again within a few days.
